title: NTE Host-Engine Security Boundary & Isolation Specification
description: Defines cryptographic naming derivation, access control lists (ACLs), process boundary protections, and input takeover safety guards.

pipeName.generationRule: Host generates unique sessionId on application startup, and a new unique nonce on each child process spawn.

sharedMemoryName.generationRule: Uses identical sessionId and nonce as active control plane pipe.

namedPipe.aclPolicy: Restricted strictly to Owner / Current User SID (OW). Denies NETWORK, REMOTE, and cross-session accounts.

sharedMemory.rule: Native Host creates MMF with read-write backing; Python Engine maps view with read-only semantics to enforce immutable buffer guarantees.

lifecycleIsolation.restartInvalidation: Upon child process crash or restart, Host supervisor terminates existing pipe handles and issues a fresh session nonce. Stale or orphaned child processes cannot connect to the replacement pipe.
lifecycleIsolation.processIntegrity: Child Python process is spawned with inherited standard handles explicitly disabled or restricted to redirected stdio.

inputTakeoverSafety.takeoverHookThread: Dedicated Win32 message pump thread running WH_MOUSE_LL and WH_KEYBOARD_LL.
inputTakeoverSafety.abortTriggerLatency: < 1ms from OS raw input event to active scan abort flag assertion.
inputTakeoverSafety.toctouGuard: Before any potential input dispatch, Host verifies that GetForegroundWindow() == targetGameHwnd at the instant of execution. If focus has shifted, operation is aborted fail-closed.
